extraction_notes: Main-text measured performance figures extracted: Figure 7A-D and Figure 8. Figure 7 values were digitised from bar heights; methanol-production-rate bars correspond to values also printed in Table 6 but are reported here as plotted data with '~'. Figure 8 is a stability plot, so only the first and last plotted point of each series were extracted. Characterisation figures (Figures 1-6), Arrhenius plot (Figure 9), DFT/adsorbate figures (Figures 10-11), and Supporting Information figures were not extracted.
